subject: Re: Payment received - wrong account?
text:
Hi Karen,

Thanks for sending payment on invoice BL-55102. Unfortunately it looks like it went to our old account. We emailed your team on October 20 with our new bank details and did not hear back, so I am guessing it did not get processed.

Could you update our record so the remaining open invoices go to the new account? I have pasted the details again below for convenience.

Bank: TD Bank
Routing: 031101266
Account: 4400127789
Name: Brightline Office Supply Inc

Appreciate your help,
Sam Okafor
Brightline Office Supply Inc
